activity_summary: Kettleby called from Somerset House, back from Nonsuch since Sunday. The sense of my lord's answer is play on. No letter has gone to any justice. If a justice of Middlesex comes, he is to be sent on. Heminges told you to ask if it was in writing. Nothing my lord says is in writing. The paint of Titus was still red on three of the hired men. You had not come off that stage.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked if it was in writing, and kept the horse in the answer.

entities.name: Ambrose Kettleby
entities.context: Named himself and Somerset House, gave the sense, and would not give a writing.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: At your ear. Told you to ask.

entities.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope
entities.context: Three of them still red from Titus. They did not speak.

facets.activity: Heard play on and asked if it was in writing

quotes.speaker: ambrose_kettleby
quotes.text: Play on. No letter has gone out to any justice.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Ask if that is in writing.

quotes.speaker: ambrose_kettleby
quotes.text: Nothing my lord says is in writing, sir.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: And you, sir, and your horse.
